newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian bourse rises on buoyant trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian bourse rises on buoyant trade.

text.p: Estonia's infant bourse rose on Tuesday amid buoyant trade, dealers said.
Overall market volume was a hefty 18.1 million kroons and the index rose 0.72 percent to 109.66.
Leading Estonian bank Hansa Bank was the most active listing in trade of eight million kroons and its shares gained, closing at 108.00 kroons versus 107.80 kroons on Monday.
Tallinn Bank saw 4.5 million kroons worth of its shares traded as it closed at 39.90 kroons versus 39.75 kroons on Monday.
"Share blocks were swapped between big investors," said one dealer, commenting on the trades involving Hansa Bank and Tallin Bank.
Volume on the secondary list was 5.6 million kroons.
